    p = plans(('inspect', 'logs', 'copy'))
    c = s.container('exited', create=True, command=['/bin/sh', '-c',
        'printf "log:%s\\n" "$1"; printf %s "$1-file" >/tmp/proof; exit 23', '_', s.token])
    s.call(['start', '-a', c], check=False)
    output = s.root / 'exited-proof'
    s.context.update(CONTAINER=c, OUTPUT=str(output))
    before = s.obj('container', c)
    assert before['State']['Status'] == 'exited' and before['State']['ExitCode'] == 23
    state = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['inspect']), c, ('/tmp/proof',))
    assert state.returncode == 0
    observed = json.loads(state.stdout)[0]
    assert observed['Id'] == before['Id'] and observed['State']['ExitCode'] == 23 and observed['State']['Status'] == 'exited'
    logs = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['logs']), c, ('/tmp/proof',))
    assert logs.returncode == 0 and logs.stdout.strip() == ('log:' + s.token).encode()
    assert s.copy(s.expand(p['copy']), {c + ':/tmp/proof', str(output)}).returncode == 0
    assert output.read_bytes() == (s.token + '-file').encode()
    assert s.obj('container', c)['Id'] == before['Id']


def signal_command(args, target, role):
    args = normalized(args)
    required_operation = 'kill' if role in ('kill', 'kill_configured') else 'stop'
    assert args[0] == required_operation and args.count(target) == 1, 'stop and kill roles cannot substitute for each other'
    words = args[1:]; words.remove(target)
    i = 0
    signal_count = 0
    while i < len(words):
        word = words[i]
        if word in ('--time', '--timeout', '-t'):
            assert args[0] == 'stop' and i + 1 < len(words)
            i += 1; assert words[i] in ('0', '1', '2', '3')
        elif word in ('--signal', '-s'):
            assert role == 'kill_configured' and i + 1 < len(words), 'default/configured stop must not be bypassed by an explicit signal'
            i += 1; assert words[i] in ('USR1', 'SIGUSR1', '10')
            signal_count += 1
        elif re.fullmatch(r'--(?:time|timeout)=[0-3]', word):
            assert args[0] == 'stop'
        elif word.startswith('--signal='):
            assert role == 'kill_configured' and word.split('=', 1)[1] in ('USR1', 'SIGUSR1', '10')
            signal_count += 1
        else:
            raise AssertionError('unapproved signal option')
        i += 1
    assert signal_count >= 1 if role == 'kill_configured' else signal_count == 0
    return args


def stop_kill_signals(s):
    p = plans(('stop', 'kill', 'stop_configured', 'kill_configured'))
    assert not s.base['Config'].get('StopSignal'), 'fixed fixture must not override default stop signal'
    script = '''trap 'printf %s "$LAB_TOKEN-term" >/tmp/signal; exit 0' TERM
trap 'printf %s "$LAB_TOKEN-usr1" >/tmp/signal; exit 0' USR1
printf ready >/tmp/ready
while :; do sleep 0.1; done'''
    roles = [('stop', 'STOP', 'term', 0), ('kill', 'KILL', None, 137),
             ('stop_configured', 'STOP_CONFIGURED', 'usr1', 0), ('kill_configured', 'KILL_CONFIGURED', 'usr1', 0)]
    for role, variable, marker, code in roles:
        tail = ['--stop-signal', 'SIGUSR1', s.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', script] if role == 'stop_configured' else None
        c = s.container(role.replace('_', '-'), command=['/bin/sh', '-c', script], env=['LAB_TOKEN=' + s.token], tail=tail)
        s.context[variable] = c
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while s.call(['exec', c, 'test', '-f', '/tmp/ready'], check=False).returncode:
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline
            time.sleep(.1)
        s.call(signal_command(s.expand(p[role]), c, role), check=False)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while s.obj('container', c)['State']['Running']:
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'signal did not end this container'
            time.sleep(.1)
        observed = s.obj('container', c)
        if role == 'stop_configured':
            assert observed['Config']['StopSignal'] == 'SIGUSR1'
        assert observed['State']['ExitCode'] == code
        output = s.root / (role + '-signal')
        copied = s.call(['cp', c + ':/tmp/signal', str(output)], check=False)
        if marker is None:
            assert copied.returncode != 0 and not output.exists(), 'default kill must not run a trap'
        else:
            assert copied.returncode == 0 and output.read_bytes() == (s.token + '-' + marker).encode()


def namespaces_cgroups(s):
    p = plans(('namespace_a', 'namespace_b', 'memory', 'cpu'))
    a, b = s.container('namespace-a'), s.container('namespace-b')
    s.context.update(A=a, B=b)
    values = []
    for key, target in [('namespace_a', a), ('namespace_b', b)]:
        result = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p[key]), target, ('/proc/1/ns/pid', '/proc/self/ns/pid'))
        assert result.returncode == 0 and re.fullmatch(rb'pid:\[[0-9]+\]\s*', result.stdout)
        values.append(result.stdout.strip())
    assert values[0] != values[1], 'separate containers need separate PID namespace views'
    memory = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['memory']), a, ('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max', '/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max'))
    cpu = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['cpu']), a, ('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max', '/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max'))
    assert memory.returncode == cpu.returncode == 0
    assert int(memory.stdout.strip()) == s.obj('container', a)['HostConfig']['Memory'] == 33554432
    quota, period = map(int, cpu.stdout.split())
    assert quota > 0 and period > 0 and quota * 4 == period


def storage_root(s):
    p = plans(('info', 'image'))
    args = s.expand(p['info'])
    assert args in (['info', '--format', '{{json .}}'], ['info', '--format={{json .}}'], ['version', '--format', '{{json .}}'])
    info = json.loads(s.call(args).stdout)
    assert info['ID'] == s.approved_id and isinstance(info['DockerRootDir'], str) and info['DockerRootDir'].startswith('/')
    assert isinstance(info['Driver'], str) and info['Driver']
    image = json.loads(image_inspect(s, s.expand(p['image'])).stdout)[0]
    assert image['Id'] == s.image_id and image['RootFS']['Type'] == 'layers'


def image_layers(s):
    p = plans(('image', 'diff_a', 'diff_b'))
    a, b = s.container('layer-a'), s.container('layer-b')
    s.context.update(A=a, B=b)
    original_layers = list(s.base['RootFS']['Layers'])
    assert original_layers and all(re.fullmatch('sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', value) for value in original_layers)
    s.call(['exec', a, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'printf %s "$1" >/layer-proof', '_', s.token])
    image = json.loads(image_inspect(s, s.expand(p['image'])).stdout)[0]
    assert image['Id'] == s.image_id and image['RootFS']['Layers'] == original_layers
    for key, target, changed in [('diff_a', a, True), ('diff_b', b, False)]:
        args = normalized(s.expand(p[key])); assert args in (['diff', a], ['diff', b])
        lines = s.call(args).stdout.decode().splitlines()
        assert any(line in ('A /layer-proof', 'C /layer-proof') for line in lines) == changed
        assert s.obj('container', target)['Image'] == s.image_id
    s.call(['exec', b, 'test', '!', '-e', '/layer-proof'])
    assert s.obj('image', s.image)['RootFS']['Layers'] == original_layers


def cnm_objects(s):
    p = plans(('connect', 'container', 'network'))
    a, b = s.network('cnm-a'), s.network('cnm-b')
    c = s.prefix + '-cnm-container'; s.containers.append(c)
    s.intent()
    s.call(['run', '--pull=never', '-d', '--name', c, '--label', 'opsforge.session06.run=' + s.token,
            '--network', a, '--cap-drop=ALL', '--security-opt=no-new-privileges', '--pids-limit=32', '--memory=32m',
            s.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'exec sleep 300'])
    before = s.obj('container', c)
    s.context.update(NET_A=a, NET_B=b, CONTAINER=c)
    args = s.expand(p['connect'])
    assert args in (['network', 'connect', b, c], ['network', 'connect', '--alias', 'lab', b, c],
                    ['network', 'connect', a, c], ['network', 'disconnect', a, c])
    assert s.call(args, check=False).returncode == 0
    cargs = normalized(s.expand(p['container'])); assert cargs == ['inspect', c]
    nargs = s.expand(p['network']); assert nargs in (['network', 'inspect', a], ['network', 'inspect', b])
    container = json.loads(s.call(cargs).stdout)[0]
    network = json.loads(s.call(nargs).stdout)[0]
    assert container['Id'] == before['Id'] and container['NetworkSettings']['SandboxID'] == before['NetworkSettings']['SandboxID']
    attached = container['NetworkSettings']['Networks']
    assert a in attached and b in attached and attached[a]['EndpointID'] != attached[b]['EndpointID']
    assert attached[b]['NetworkID'] == network['Id'] and network['Name'] == b
    assert attached[b]['EndpointID'] and network['Containers'][container['Id']]['EndpointID'] == attached[b]['EndpointID']


def host_pid(s):
    p = plans(('host', 'inside'))
    c = s.container('pid'); s.context['CONTAINER'] = c
    actual = s.obj('container', c)['State']['Pid']; assert actual > 1
    host = normalized(s.expand(p['host']))
    inside = normalized(s.expand(p['inside']))
    valid = (['top', c, '-eo', 'pid,comm'], ['top', c, '-o', 'pid,comm'], ['exec', c, 'cat', '/proc/1/stat'])
    assert host in valid and inside in valid
    host_out, inside_out = s.call(host).stdout, s.call(inside).stdout
    assert any(line.split()[0] == str(actual).encode() for line in host_out.splitlines() if line.split())
    assert inside_out.split(maxsplit=1)[0] == b'1'


def persistent_volume(s):
    p = plans(('mount',))
    volume = s.volume('persistent'); s.context['VOLUME'] = volume
    args = s.expand(p['mount'])
    options = (['-v', volume + ':/data'], ['--volume=' + volume + ':/data'],
               ['--mount', 'type=volume,src=' + volume + ',dst=/data'],
               ['--mount=type=volume,source=' + volume + ',target=/data'],
               ['-v', volume + ':/scratch'], ['-v', volume + ':/data:ro'])
    assert args in options
    writer = s.container('writer', mounts=args)
    s.call(['exec', writer, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'mkdir -p /data; printf %s "$1" >/data/proof', '_', s.token])
    before = s.obj('container', writer)
    assert any(m['Type'] == 'volume' and m['Name'] == volume and m['Destination'] == '/data' for m in before['Mounts'])
    s.call(['rm', '-f', writer])
    reader = s.container('reader', mounts=args)
    assert s.obj('container', reader)['Id'] != before['Id']
    assert s.call(['exec', reader, 'cat', '/data/proof']).stdout == s.token.encode()


def docker_purpose(s):
    p = plans(('read_a', 'stop_a'))
    a, b = s.container('purpose-a'), s.container('purpose-b')
    s.context.update(A=a, B=b)
    for target, value in ((a, s.token + '-a'), (b, s.token + '-b')):
        s.call(['exec', target, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'printf %s "$1" >/tmp/identity', '_', value])
    result = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['read_a']), a, ('/tmp/identity',))
    assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout == (s.token + '-a').encode()
    args = target_command(s.expand(p['stop_a']), a, ('stop', 'start', 'restart'))
    s.call(args)
    first, second = s.obj('container', a), s.obj('container', b)
    assert not first['State']['Running'] and second['State']['Running']
    assert first['Id'] != second['Id'] and first['Image'] == second['Image'] == s.image_id
    assert s.call(['exec', b, 'cat', '/tmp/identity']).stdout == (s.token + '-b').encode()


def runtime_practices(s):
    p = plans(('options',))
    args = s.expand(p['options'])
    allowed = (
        ['--user', '1000:1000', '--read-only', '--tmpfs', '/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=4m'],
        ['--read-only', '--user=1000:1000', '--tmpfs=/tmp:rw,nosuid,noexec,size=4194304'],
        ['--user', '0:0', '--read-only', '--tmpfs', '/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=4m'],
        ['--user', '1000:1000', '--tmpfs', '/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=4m'],
    )
    assert args in allowed
    c = s.container('safe-runtime', tail=[*args, s.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'exec sleep 300'])
    obj = s.obj('container', c)
    assert obj['Config']['User'] == '1000:1000' and obj['HostConfig']['ReadonlyRootfs'] is True
    assert 'ALL' in obj['HostConfig']['CapDrop'] and 'no-new-privileges' in obj['HostConfig']['SecurityOpt']
    assert obj['HostConfig']['Memory'] == 33554432 and obj['HostConfig']['PidsLimit'] == 32
    assert s.call(['exec', c, 'id', '-u']).stdout.strip() == b'1000'
    status = s.call(['exec', c, 'cat', '/proc/1/status']).stdout.decode()
    assert re.search(r'^NoNewPrivs:\s+1$', status, re.M) and re.search(r'^CapEff:\s+0+$', status, re.M)
    mountinfo = s.call(['exec', c, 'cat', '/proc/self/mountinfo']).stdout.decode().splitlines()
    assert any(line.split()[4] == '/' and 'ro' in line.split()[5].split(',') for line in mountinfo)
    assert s.call(['exec', c, 'touch', '/root-proof'], check=False).returncode != 0
    s.call(['exec', c, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'printf %s "$1" >/tmp/proof', '_', s.token])
    assert s.call(['exec', c, 'cat', '/tmp/proof']).stdout == s.token.encode()


CHECKS2 = {
 'curated-feishu-project-018': exited_forensics,
 'curated-feishu-w-020': stop_kill_signals,
 'src-1ad330c464daa294': namespaces_cgroups,
 'src-1108be2ae400b1de': storage_root,
 'src-183125f3433a985f': image_layers,
 'src-be9361a3aaa4a081': cnm_objects,
 'src-23c4da2bec8eded9': host_pid,
 'src-0dcf992ed26176bc': persistent_volume,
 'src-cd95f465cc6d1ff7': docker_purpose,
 'src-f82ebf887296b9f9': runtime_practices,
}


def run(qid):
    s = Native2()
    try:
        s.enter()
        CHECKS2[qid](s)
    finally:
        s.finish()

"""Trusted native Docker driver. Learner JSON is argv data, never executable code."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import secrets
import signal
import stat
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
from urllib.parse import urlsplit


class NativeEnvironmentUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    pass


def validate_audit_path(name):
    assert name in ('native-intent.json', 'native-trace.json')
    path = Path(name)
    try:
        info = path.lstat()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return
    assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) and info.st_nlink == 1, 'audit output must be an ordinary single-link file'


def write_audit_json(name, value):
    validate_audit_path(name)
    descriptor, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.opsforge-audit-', suffix='.tmp', dir='.')
    try:
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True)
            stream.flush()
        validate_audit_path(name)
        # Replace the entry atomically; never open/follow the destination inode.
        os.replace(temporary, name)
    finally:
        try:
            os.unlink(temporary)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass


def unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        assert key not in result, 'duplicate JSON key'
        result[key] = value
    return result


def plans(keys):
    path = Path('commands.json')
    assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and path.stat().st_size < 16000
    result = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=unique_object)
    assert isinstance(result, dict) and set(result) == set(keys), 'exact requested native command roles required'
    for args in result.values():
        assert isinstance(args, list) and 1 <= len(args) <= 20
        assert all(isinstance(x, str) and 0 < len(x) < 2048 and '\x00' not in x for x in args)
    return result


def normalized(args):
    result = list(args)
    if result[0] == 'container':
        result = result[1:]
        if result and result[0] == 'remove':
            result[0] = 'rm'
    assert result
    return result


def target_command(args, target, operations):
    args = normalized(args)
    assert args[0] in operations
    assert args.count(target) == 1, 'operation must target this fixture container only'
    options = args[1:]
    options.remove(target)
    i = 0
    while i < len(options):
        word = options[i]
        if word in ('-f', '--force', '-v', '--volumes'):
            assert args[0] == 'rm'
        elif word in ('-t', '--time', '--timeout'):
            assert args[0] in ('stop', 'restart') and i + 1 < len(options)
            i += 1
            assert options[i] in ('0', '1', '2', '3')
        elif re.fullmatch(r'--(?:time|timeout)=[0-3]', word):
            assert args[0] in ('stop', 'restart')
        else:
            raise AssertionError('unapproved native option: ' + word)
        i += 1
    return args


class Native:
    def __init__(self):
        if os.getuid() != 1000 or os.environ.get('WSL_DISTRO_NAME') != 'OpsForge-Validation-20261022':
            raise NativeEnvironmentUnavailable('explicit OpsForge-Validation-20261022 / student UID1000 required')
        validate_audit_path('native-intent.json')
        validate_audit_path('native-trace.json')
        required = ('OPSFORGE_DOCKER_BIN', 'OPSFORGE_DOCKER_CLI_SHA256', 'OPSFORGE_DOCKER_HOST', 'OPSFORGE_LAB_ENGINE_ID', 'OPSFORGE_LAB_IMAGE')
        missing = [key for key in required if not os.environ.get(key)]
        if missing:
            raise NativeEnvironmentUnavailable('trusted native environment not connected: ' + ','.join(missing))
        self.binary = Path(os.environ['OPSFORGE_DOCKER_BIN']).resolve(strict=True)
        self.tool_hash = os.environ['OPSFORGE_DOCKER_CLI_SHA256']
        assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', self.tool_hash)
        self.host = os.environ['OPSFORGE_DOCKER_HOST']
        endpoint = urlsplit(self.host)
        assert endpoint.scheme in ('unix', 'tcp')
        if endpoint.scheme == 'tcp':
            assert endpoint.hostname in ('127.0.0.1', 'localhost', '::1') and endpoint.port
        else:
            assert endpoint.path.startswith('/') and not endpoint.netloc
        self.approved_id = os.environ['OPSFORGE_LAB_ENGINE_ID']
        self.image = os.environ['OPSFORGE_LAB_IMAGE']
        assert re.fullmatch(r'(?:[A-Za-z0-9./:_-]+@)?sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', self.image), 'preloaded immutable image identity required'
        self.temp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-s06-runtime-')
        self.root = Path(self.temp.name)
        self.config = self.root / 'docker-config'
        self.config.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        self.token = secrets.token_hex(12)
        self.prefix = 'opsforge-s06-' + self.token
        self.containers = []
        self.volumes = []
        self.tags = []
        self.trace = []
        self.context = {}
        self.env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.upper().startswith(('DOCKER_', 'COMPOSE_'))}
        self.base = None
        self.ready = False

    def intent(self):
        write_audit_json('native-intent.json', {'token': self.token, 'containers': self.containers, 'volumes': self.volumes,
            'tags': self.tags, 'networks': getattr(self, 'networks', []), 'host': self.host,
            'engine_id': self.approved_id, 'image': self.image, 'cli_sha256': self.tool_hash})

    def command(self, args):
        assert hashlib.sha256(self.binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == self.tool_hash, 'Docker CLI changed'
        return [str(self.binary), '--config', str(self.config), '--host', self.host, *args]

    def call(self, args, check=True, timeout=12):
        argv = self.command(args)
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(argv, env=self.env, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            self.trace.append({'argv': argv, 'timeout': timeout, 'stdout': (error.stdout or b'').decode(errors='replace'),
                               'stderr': (error.stderr or b'').decode(errors='replace')})
            raise
        self.trace.append({'argv': argv, 'returncode': result.returncode,
                           'stdout': result.stdout.decode(errors='replace'), 'stderr': result.stderr.decode(errors='replace')})
        if check:
            assert result.returncode == 0, self.trace[-1]
        return result

    def obj(self, kind, name, check=True):
        result = self.call([kind, 'inspect', name], check=check)
        if result.returncode:
            error = result.stderr.decode(errors='replace').lower()
            absent = {'container': 'no such container: ' + name.lower(),
                      'image': 'no such image: ' + name.lower(),
                      'volume': 'get ' + name.lower() + ': no such volume',
                      'network': 'network ' + name.lower() + ' not found'}
            if not check and absent.get(kind, '\x00') in error:
                return None
            raise NativeEnvironmentUnavailable('inspect could not establish object state: ' + error[:500])
        return json.loads(result.stdout)[0]

    def enter(self):
        info = json.loads(self.call(['info', '--format', '{{json .}}']).stdout)
        assert info['ID'] == self.approved_id, 'approved Engine identity mismatch'
        self.base = self.obj('image', self.image)
        self.image_id = self.base['Id']
        self.protected_tags = {tag for tag in (self.base.get('RepoTags') or [])
                               if not re.fullmatch(r'opsforge-s06-[a-f0-9]{24}:[ab]', tag)}
        self.concurrent_session_tags = sorted(set(self.base.get('RepoTags') or []) - self.protected_tags)
        concurrent_repositories = {tag.rsplit(':', 1)[0] for tag in self.concurrent_session_tags}
        self.protected_digests = {digest for digest in (self.base.get('RepoDigests') or [])
                                  if digest.split('@', 1)[0] not in concurrent_repositories}
        self.concurrent_session_digests = sorted(set(self.base.get('RepoDigests') or []) - self.protected_digests)
        self.context['IMAGE'] = self.image
        self.ready = True
        print('NATIVE_DOCKER_READY:' + json.dumps({'engine_id': info['ID'], 'engine_name': info.get('Name'),
            'server_version': info.get('ServerVersion'), 'security_options': info.get('SecurityOptions'),
            'image_id': self.image_id, 'cli_sha256': self.tool_hash, 'uid': os.getuid(),
            'wsl_distro': os.environ.get('WSL_DISTRO_NAME')}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
        return self

    def expand(self, args):
        result = []
        for arg in args:
            value = re.sub(r'\$\{([A-Z_]+)\}', lambda m: self.context[m[1]], arg)
            assert '${' not in value and '\x00' not in value
            result.append(value)
        return result

    def volume(self, role):
        name = self.prefix + '-' + role
        assert self.obj('volume', name, check=False) is None
        self.volumes.append((name, True))
        self.intent()
        self.call(['volume', 'create', '--label', 'opsforge.session06.run=' + self.token, name])
        return name

    def container(self, role, command=None, mounts=(), env=(), detach=True, create=False, tail=None):
        name = self.prefix + '-' + role
        assert self.obj('container', name, check=False) is None
        self.containers.append(name)
        self.intent()
        args = ['create' if create else 'run', '--pull=never', '--name', name,
                '--label', 'opsforge.session06.run=' + self.token, '--network=none',
                '--cap-drop=ALL', '--security-opt=no-new-privileges', '--pids-limit=32', '--memory=32m', '--cpus=0.25']
        if detach and not create:
            args += ['-d']
        for value in env:
            args += ['-e', value]
        args += list(mounts)
        args += list(tail) if tail is not None else [self.image, *(command or ['/bin/sh', '-c', 'exec sleep 300'])]
        self.call(args)
        return name

    def helper(self, volume, script, *args, check=True):
        name = self.prefix + '-helper-' + secrets.token_hex(4)
        self.containers.append(name)
        self.intent()
        return self.call(['run', '--pull=never', '--rm', '--name', name, '--label', 'opsforge.session06.run=' + self.token,
            '--network=none', '--cap-drop=ALL', '--security-opt=no-new-privileges', '--pids-limit=16', '--memory=32m',
            '--mount', 'type=volume,src=' + volume + ',dst=/data', self.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', script, '_', *args], check=check)

    def read(self, args, target):
        args = normalized(args)
        if args[0] in ('diff', 'inspect', 'logs'):
            assert args == [args[0], target]
        elif args[0] == 'exec':
            assert len(args) >= 4 and args[1] == target
            tail = args[2:]
            allowed = ('/data/volume-proof', '/data/proof', '/writable-proof', '/tmp/exec-proof')
            assert (len(tail) == 2 and tail[0] in ('cat', '/bin/cat') and tail[1] in allowed) or (
                len(tail) == 3 and tail[0] in ('sh', '/bin/sh') and tail[1] == '-c' and tail[2] in ['cat ' + path for path in allowed])
        else:
            raise AssertionError('only bounded read operations on this fixture are accepted')
        return self.call(args, check=False)

    def copy(self, args, endpoints):
        args = normalized(args)
        assert args[0] == 'cp'
        options = [word for word in args[1:] if word not in ('-a', '--archive')]
        assert len(options) == 2 and all(word in endpoints for word in options)
        assert any(':' in word for word in options), 'one endpoint must be this fixture container'
        return self.call(args, check=False)

    def finish(self):
        errors = []
        for name in reversed(self.containers):
            try:
                obj = self.obj('container', name, check=False)
                if obj is None:
                    continue
                if obj.get('Config', {}).get('Labels', {}).get('opsforge.session06.run') != self.token:
                    errors.append('refuse foreign container ' + name)
                    continue
                self.call(['rm', '-f', '-v', name], check=False)
                if self.obj('container', name, check=False) is not None:
                    errors.append('container remains ' + name)
            except Exception as error:
                errors.append('container cleanup failed ' + name + ': ' + str(error))
        for name, labeled in reversed(self.volumes):
            try:
                obj = self.obj('volume', name, check=False)
                if obj is None:
                    continue
                if labeled and obj.get('Labels', {}).get('opsforge.session06.run') != self.token:
                    errors.append('refuse foreign volume ' + name)
                    continue
                self.call(['volume', 'rm', name], check=False)
                if self.obj('volume', name, check=False) is not None:
                    errors.append('volume remains ' + name)
            except Exception as error:
                errors.append('volume cleanup failed ' + name + ': ' + str(error))
        for name in reversed(self.tags):
            try:
                obj = self.obj('image', name, check=False)
                if obj is None:
                    continue
                if obj['Id'] != self.image_id:
                    errors.append('refuse changed tag ' + name)
                    continue
                self.call(['image', 'rm', name], check=False)
                if self.obj('image', name, check=False) is not None:
                    errors.append('tag remains ' + name)
            except Exception as error:
                errors.append('tag cleanup failed ' + name + ': ' + str(error))
        if self.base is not None:
            try:
                after = self.obj('image', self.image)
                before_tags, after_tags = self.protected_tags, set(after.get('RepoTags') or [])
                before_digests, after_digests = self.protected_digests, set(after.get('RepoDigests') or [])
                if after['Id'] != self.base['Id'] or not before_tags <= after_tags or not before_digests <= after_digests:
                    errors.append('pre-existing image references changed')
                self.trace.append({'preexisting_image_preserved': not errors,
                                   'concurrent_session_temp_tags_at_start': self.concurrent_session_tags,
                                   'concurrent_session_derived_digests_at_start': self.concurrent_session_digests,
                                   'new_foreign_tags_preserved': sorted(after_tags - before_tags),
                                   'new_foreign_digests_preserved': sorted(after_digests - before_digests)})
            except Exception as error:
                errors.append('cannot verify pre-existing image: ' + str(error))
        print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_LEDGER:' + json.dumps({'containers': self.containers, 'volumes': self.volumes,
            'tags': self.tags, 'errors': errors}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
        output = Path('native-trace.json')
        try:
            write_audit_json('native-trace.json', {'trace': self.trace, 'containers': self.containers,
                'volumes': self.volumes, 'tags': self.tags, 'cleanup_errors': errors,
                'cli_sha256': self.tool_hash, 'engine_id': self.approved_id,
                'image': self.image, 'wsl_distro': os.environ.get('WSL_DISTRO_NAME'), 'uid': os.getuid(),
                'native_ready': self.ready})
            print('NATIVE_RAW_TRACE_FILE:' + json.dumps({'path': str(output), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                'command_count': len(self.trace)}, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
        finally:
            self.temp.cleanup()
        assert not errors, errors
        print('NATIVE_OWN_RESOURCES_CLEANED', flush=True)


def mount_options(args, sources):
    assert len(args) in (1, 2)
    if len(args) == 1:
        assert args[0].startswith(('--mount=', '--volume='))
        option, value = args[0].split('=', 1)
    else:
        option, value = args
    assert option in ('-v', '--volume', '--mount')
    if option in ('-v', '--volume'):
        assert value in [source + suffix for source in sources for suffix in (':/data', ':/data:ro')]
    else:
        fields = {}
        for field in value.split(','):
            key, _, item = field.partition('=')
            assert key not in fields
            fields[key] = item
        assert set(fields) <= {'type', 'src', 'source', 'dst', 'target', 'destination', 'readonly', 'ro'}
        assert fields.get('type') == 'bind'
        assert len(set(fields) & {'src', 'source'}) == 1
        assert fields.get('src', fields.get('source')) in sources
        assert len(set(fields) & {'dst', 'target', 'destination'}) == 1
        assert fields.get('dst', fields.get('target', fields.get('destination'))) == '/data'
        assert all(fields[key] in ('', 'true') for key in ('readonly', 'ro') if key in fields)
    return args


def bind_missing(s):
    p = plans(('v', 'mount'))
    root = s.volume('bind-root')
    mountpoint = s.obj('volume', root)['Mountpoint']
    v, m = mountpoint + '/missing-v', mountpoint + '/missing-mount'
    s.context.update(SOURCE_V=v, SOURCE_M=m)
    s.helper(root, 'test ! -e /data/missing-v && test ! -e /data/missing-mount')
    for key in ('v', 'mount'):
        options = mount_options(s.expand(p[key]), (v, m))
        name = s.prefix + '-' + key
        s.containers.append(name)
        s.intent()
        result = s.call(['run', '--pull=never', '--name', name, '--label', 'opsforge.session06.run=' + s.token,
            '--network=none', '--cap-drop=ALL', '--security-opt=no-new-privileges', *options,
            s.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'test -d /data'], check=False)
        if key == 'v':
            assert result.returncode == 0, 'short volume syntax must create missing bind directory'
            obj = s.obj('container', name)
            assert len(obj['Mounts']) == 1 and obj['Mounts'][0]['Type'] == 'bind' and obj['Mounts'][0]['Source'] == v
            s.helper(root, 'test -d /data/missing-v')
        else:
            assert result.returncode != 0, 'plain --mount must reject the missing source'
            s.helper(root, 'test ! -e /data/missing-mount')


def tag_remove(s):
    p = plans(('remove',))
    assert s.protected_tags, 'fixture must have a stable pre-existing tag so cleanup preserves the original image'
    a, b = s.prefix + ':a', s.prefix + ':b'
    s.context.update(TAG_A=a, TAG_B=b)
    for name in (a, b):
        assert s.obj('image', name, check=False) is None
        s.tags.append(name); s.intent()
        s.call(['image', 'tag', s.image, name])
        assert s.obj('image', name)['Id'] == s.image_id
    args = s.expand(p['remove'])
    if args[0] == 'image':
        assert len(args) == 3 and args[1] in ('rm', 'remove') and args[2] in (a, b)
    else:
        assert len(args) == 2 and args[0] == 'rmi' and args[1] in (a, b)
    s.call(args)
    assert s.obj('image', a, check=False) is None, 'requested first tag still exists'
    assert s.obj('image', b)['Id'] == s.image_id
    assert s.obj('image', s.image)['Id'] == s.image_id


def diff_volume(s):
    p = plans(('layer', 'volume'))
    volume = s.volume('diff-data')
    c = s.container('diff', mounts=['--mount', 'type=volume,src=' + volume + ',dst=/data'])
    s.context['CONTAINER'] = c
    s.call(['exec', c, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'printf %s "$1" >/writable-proof; printf %s "$2" >/data/volume-proof', '_', s.token + '-layer', s.token + '-volume'])
    layer = s.read(s.expand(p['layer']), c)
    assert layer.returncode == 0
    changes = layer.stdout.decode().splitlines()
    assert any(line in ('A /writable-proof', 'C /writable-proof') for line in changes)
    assert not any(line.endswith(' /data/volume-proof') for line in changes)
    data = s.read(s.expand(p['volume']), c)
    assert data.returncode == 0 and data.stdout == (s.token + '-volume').encode(), 'diff is not a read of mounted data'
    assert any(x['Type'] == 'volume' and x['Name'] == volume and x['Destination'] == '/data' for x in s.obj('container', c)['Mounts'])


def final_command(s):
    p = plans(('create',))
    args = s.expand(p['create'])
    # Only safe entrypoint/argv combinations are accepted, then Engine resolves them.
    tails = [
        ['--entrypoint', '/bin/sh', s.image, '-c', 'exec sleep 300'],
        ['--entrypoint=/bin/sh', s.image, '-c', 'exec sleep 300'],
        [s.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'exec sleep 300'],
        ['--entrypoint', '/bin/sh', s.image, '-c', 'sleep 300'],
    ]
    assert args in tails, 'only this safe shell/sleep fixture command may be created'
    c = s.container('command', tail=args)
    obj = s.obj('container', c)
    assert obj['Image'] == s.image_id and obj['Config']['Entrypoint'] == ['/bin/sh']
    assert obj['Path'] == '/bin/sh' and obj['Args'] == ['-c', 'exec sleep 300']
    assert obj['State']['Running'] is True and obj['State']['Pid'] > 0


def copy_both(s):
    p = plans(('put', 'get_running', 'get_stopped'))
    c = s.container('copy')
    src, running, stopped = [s.root / name for name in ('input.bin', 'running.bin', 'stopped.bin')]
    content = secrets.token_bytes(257)
    src.write_bytes(content)
    remote = c + ':/tmp/payload.bin'
    s.context.update(CONTAINER=c, INPUT=str(src), OUT_RUNNING=str(running), OUT_STOPPED=str(stopped))
    endpoints = {str(src), str(running), str(stopped), remote}
    assert s.copy(s.expand(p['put']), endpoints).returncode == 0
    assert s.copy(s.expand(p['get_running']), endpoints).returncode == 0
    assert running.is_file() and running.read_bytes() == content
    original_id = s.obj('container', c)['Id']
    s.call(['stop', '--time', '1', c])
    assert s.obj('container', c)['State']['Status'] == 'exited'
    assert s.copy(s.expand(p['get_stopped']), endpoints).returncode == 0
    assert stopped.is_file() and stopped.read_bytes() == content
    assert s.obj('container', c)['Id'] == original_id


def restart_same(s):
    p = plans(('restart',))
    c = s.container('restart', env=['LAB_VALUE=' + s.token + '-before'])

    s.call(['exec', c, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'printf %s "$LAB_VALUE" >/proof'])

def lifecycle_data(s):
    p = plans(('copy_stopped', 'remove', 'read_new'))
    volume = s.volume('lifecycle')
    old = s.container('old', mounts=['--mount', 'type=volume,src=' + volume + ',dst=/data'])
    output = s.root / 'layer-after-stop'
    s.context.update(OLD=old, LAYER_OUTPUT=str(output))

def volume_lifetime(s):
    p = plans(('remove_plain', 'remove_with_v'))
    volume = s.volume('named')
    for role, key, removed in [('plain', 'remove_plain', False), ('with-v', 'remove_with_v', True)]:

def http_probe(s, args, c):

    p = plans(('probe',))

        self.networks.append(name)
        self.intent()
        self.call(['network', 'create', '--driver', 'bridge', '--internal', '--label', 'opsforge.session06.run=' + self.token, name])
        return name

    def finish(self):
        errors = []
        if self.networks:
            for name in self.containers:
                try:
                    obj = self.obj('container', name, check=False)
                    if obj is not None:
                        assert obj['Config']['Labels'].get('opsforge.session06.run') == self.token
                        self.call(['rm', '-f', '-v', name])
                except Exception as error:
                    errors.append('network container cleanup: ' + name + ': ' + str(error))
            for name in self.networks:
                try:
                    obj = self.obj('network', name, check=False)
                    if obj is not None:
                        assert obj['Labels'].get('opsforge.session06.run') == self.token
                        self.call(['network', 'rm', name])
                    assert self.obj('network', name, check=False) is None
                except Exception as error:
                    errors.append('network cleanup: ' + name + ': ' + str(error))
        try:
            super().finish()
        finally:
            output = Path('native-trace.json')
            if output.is_file() and not output.is_symlink():
                validate_audit_path('native-trace.json')
                raw = json.loads(output.read_text())
                raw['networks'] = self.networks
                raw['cleanup_errors'].extend(errors)
                write_audit_json('native-trace.json', raw)
        assert not errors, errors


def bounded_read(s, args, target, paths):
    args = normalized(args)
    if args[0] in ('inspect', 'logs'):
        assert args == [args[0], target]
    else:
        assert len(args) == 4 and args[0:2] == ['exec', target]
        assert args[2] in ('cat', '/bin/cat', 'readlink', '/bin/readlink') and args[3] in paths
    return s.call(args, check=False)


def image_inspect(s, args):
    assert args in (['image', 'inspect', s.image], ['inspect', '--type=image', s.image])
    return s.call(args)


def exited_forensics(s):
    p = plans(('inspect', 'logs', 'copy'))
    c = s.container('exited', create=True, command=['/bin/sh', '-c',
        'printf "log:%s\\n" "$1"; printf %s "$1-file" >/tmp/proof; exit 23', '_', s.token])
    s.call(['start', '-a', c], check=False)
    output = s.root / 'exited-proof'
    s.context.update(CONTAINER=c, OUTPUT=str(output))
    before = s.obj('container', c)
    assert before['State']['Status'] == 'exited' and before['State']['ExitCode'] == 23
    state = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['inspect']), c, ('/tmp/proof',))
    assert state.returncode == 0
    observed = json.loads(state.stdout)[0]
    assert observed['Id'] == before['Id'] and observed['State']['ExitCode'] == 23 and observed['State']['Status'] == 'exited'
    logs = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['logs']), c, ('/tmp/proof',))
    assert logs.returncode == 0 and logs.stdout.strip() == ('log:' + s.token).encode()
    assert s.copy(s.expand(p['copy']), {c + ':/tmp/proof', str(output)}).returncode == 0
    assert output.read_bytes() == (s.token + '-file').encode()
    assert s.obj('container', c)['Id'] == before['Id']


def signal_command(args, target, role):
    args = normalized(args)
    required_operation = 'kill' if role in ('kill', 'kill_configured') else 'stop'
    assert args[0] == required_operation and args.count(target) == 1, 'stop and kill roles cannot substitute for each other'
    words = args[1:]; words.remove(target)
    i = 0
    signal_count = 0
    while i < len(words):
        word = words[i]
        if word in ('--time', '--timeout', '-t'):
            assert args[0] == 'stop' and i + 1 < len(words)
            i += 1; assert words[i] in ('0', '1', '2', '3')
        elif word in ('--signal', '-s'):
            assert role == 'kill_configured' and i + 1 < len(words), 'default/configured stop must not be bypassed by an explicit signal'
            i += 1; assert words[i] in ('USR1', 'SIGUSR1', '10')
            signal_count += 1
        elif re.fullmatch(r'--(?:time|timeout)=[0-3]', word):
            assert args[0] == 'stop'
        elif word.startswith('--signal='):
            assert role == 'kill_configured' and word.split('=', 1)[1] in ('USR1', 'SIGUSR1', '10')
            signal_count += 1
        else:
            raise AssertionError('unapproved signal option')
        i += 1
    assert signal_count >= 1 if role == 'kill_configured' else signal_count == 0
    return args


def stop_kill_signals(s):
    p = plans(('stop', 'kill', 'stop_configured', 'kill_configured'))
    assert not s.base['Config'].get('StopSignal'), 'fixed fixture must not override default stop signal'
    script = '''trap 'printf %s "$LAB_TOKEN-term" >/tmp/signal; exit 0' TERM
trap 'printf %s "$LAB_TOKEN-usr1" >/tmp/signal; exit 0' USR1
printf ready >/tmp/ready
while :; do sleep 0.1; done'''
    roles = [('stop', 'STOP', 'term', 0), ('kill', 'KILL', None, 137),
             ('stop_configured', 'STOP_CONFIGURED', 'usr1', 0), ('kill_configured', 'KILL_CONFIGURED', 'usr1', 0)]
    for role, variable, marker, code in roles:
        tail = ['--stop-signal', 'SIGUSR1', s.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', script] if role == 'stop_configured' else None
        c = s.container(role.replace('_', '-'), command=['/bin/sh', '-c', script], env=['LAB_TOKEN=' + s.token], tail=tail)
        s.context[variable] = c
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while s.call(['exec', c, 'test', '-f', '/tmp/ready'], check=False).returncode:
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline
            time.sleep(.1)
        s.call(signal_command(s.expand(p[role]), c, role), check=False)
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while s.obj('container', c)['State']['Running']:
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'signal did not end this container'
            time.sleep(.1)
        observed = s.obj('container', c)
        if role == 'stop_configured':
            assert observed['Config']['StopSignal'] == 'SIGUSR1'
        assert observed['State']['ExitCode'] == code
        output = s.root / (role + '-signal')
        copied = s.call(['cp', c + ':/tmp/signal', str(output)], check=False)
        if marker is None:
            assert copied.returncode != 0 and not output.exists(), 'default kill must not run a trap'
        else:
            assert copied.returncode == 0 and output.read_bytes() == (s.token + '-' + marker).encode()


def namespaces_cgroups(s):
    p = plans(('namespace_a', 'namespace_b', 'memory', 'cpu'))
    a, b = s.container('namespace-a'), s.container('namespace-b')
    s.context.update(A=a, B=b)
    values = []
    for key, target in [('namespace_a', a), ('namespace_b', b)]:
        result = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p[key]), target, ('/proc/1/ns/pid', '/proc/self/ns/pid'))
        assert result.returncode == 0 and re.fullmatch(rb'pid:\[[0-9]+\]\s*', result.stdout)
        values.append(result.stdout.strip())
    assert values[0] != values[1], 'separate containers need separate PID namespace views'
    memory = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['memory']), a, ('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max', '/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max'))
    cpu = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['cpu']), a, ('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max', '/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max'))
    assert memory.returncode == cpu.returncode == 0
    assert int(memory.stdout.strip()) == s.obj('container', a)['HostConfig']['Memory'] == 33554432
    quota, period = map(int, cpu.stdout.split())
    assert quota > 0 and period > 0 and quota * 4 == period


def storage_root(s):
    p = plans(('info', 'image'))
    args = s.expand(p['info'])
    assert args in (['info', '--format', '{{json .}}'], ['info', '--format={{json .}}'], ['version', '--format', '{{json .}}'])
    info = json.loads(s.call(args).stdout)
    assert info['ID'] == s.approved_id and isinstance(info['DockerRootDir'], str) and info['DockerRootDir'].startswith('/')
    assert isinstance(info['Driver'], str) and info['Driver']
    image = json.loads(image_inspect(s, s.expand(p['image'])).stdout)[0]
    assert image['Id'] == s.image_id and image['RootFS']['Type'] == 'layers'


def image_layers(s):
    p = plans(('image', 'diff_a', 'diff_b'))
    a, b = s.container('layer-a'), s.container('layer-b')
    s.context.update(A=a, B=b)
    original_layers = list(s.base['RootFS']['Layers'])
    assert original_layers and all(re.fullmatch('sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', value) for value in original_layers)
    s.call(['exec', a, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'printf %s "$1" >/layer-proof', '_', s.token])
    image = json.loads(image_inspect(s, s.expand(p['image'])).stdout)[0]
    assert image['Id'] == s.image_id and image['RootFS']['Layers'] == original_layers
    for key, target, changed in [('diff_a', a, True), ('diff_b', b, False)]:
        args = normalized(s.expand(p[key])); assert args in (['diff', a], ['diff', b])
        lines = s.call(args).stdout.decode().splitlines()
        assert any(line in ('A /layer-proof', 'C /layer-proof') for line in lines) == changed
        assert s.obj('container', target)['Image'] == s.image_id
    s.call(['exec', b, 'test', '!', '-e', '/layer-proof'])
    assert s.obj('image', s.image)['RootFS']['Layers'] == original_layers


def cnm_objects(s):
    p = plans(('connect', 'container', 'network'))
    a, b = s.network('cnm-a'), s.network('cnm-b')
    c = s.prefix + '-cnm-container'; s.containers.append(c)
    s.intent()
    s.call(['run', '--pull=never', '-d', '--name', c, '--label', 'opsforge.session06.run=' + s.token,
            '--network', a, '--cap-drop=ALL', '--security-opt=no-new-privileges', '--pids-limit=32', '--memory=32m',
            s.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'exec sleep 300'])
    before = s.obj('container', c)
    s.context.update(NET_A=a, NET_B=b, CONTAINER=c)
    args = s.expand(p['connect'])
    assert args in (['network', 'connect', b, c], ['network', 'connect', '--alias', 'lab', b, c],
                    ['network', 'connect', a, c], ['network', 'disconnect', a, c])
    assert s.call(args, check=False).returncode == 0
    cargs = normalized(s.expand(p['container'])); assert cargs == ['inspect', c]
    nargs = s.expand(p['network']); assert nargs in (['network', 'inspect', a], ['network', 'inspect', b])
    container = json.loads(s.call(cargs).stdout)[0]
    network = json.loads(s.call(nargs).stdout)[0]
    assert container['Id'] == before['Id'] and container['NetworkSettings']['SandboxID'] == before['NetworkSettings']['SandboxID']
    attached = container['NetworkSettings']['Networks']
    assert a in attached and b in attached and attached[a]['EndpointID'] != attached[b]['EndpointID']
    assert attached[b]['NetworkID'] == network['Id'] and network['Name'] == b
    assert attached[b]['EndpointID'] and network['Containers'][container['Id']]['EndpointID'] == attached[b]['EndpointID']


def host_pid(s):
    p = plans(('host', 'inside'))
    c = s.container('pid'); s.context['CONTAINER'] = c
    actual = s.obj('container', c)['State']['Pid']; assert actual > 1
    host = normalized(s.expand(p['host']))
    inside = normalized(s.expand(p['inside']))
    valid = (['top', c, '-eo', 'pid,comm'], ['top', c, '-o', 'pid,comm'], ['exec', c, 'cat', '/proc/1/stat'])
    assert host in valid and inside in valid
    host_out, inside_out = s.call(host).stdout, s.call(inside).stdout
    assert any(line.split()[0] == str(actual).encode() for line in host_out.splitlines() if line.split())
    assert inside_out.split(maxsplit=1)[0] == b'1'


def persistent_volume(s):
    p = plans(('mount',))
    volume = s.volume('persistent'); s.context['VOLUME'] = volume
    args = s.expand(p['mount'])
    options = (['-v', volume + ':/data'], ['--volume=' + volume + ':/data'],
               ['--mount', 'type=volume,src=' + volume + ',dst=/data'],
               ['--mount=type=volume,source=' + volume + ',target=/data'],
               ['-v', volume + ':/scratch'], ['-v', volume + ':/data:ro'])
    assert args in options
    writer = s.container('writer', mounts=args)
    s.call(['exec', writer, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'mkdir -p /data; printf %s "$1" >/data/proof', '_', s.token])
    before = s.obj('container', writer)
    assert any(m['Type'] == 'volume' and m['Name'] == volume and m['Destination'] == '/data' for m in before['Mounts'])
    s.call(['rm', '-f', writer])
    reader = s.container('reader', mounts=args)
    assert s.obj('container', reader)['Id'] != before['Id']
    assert s.call(['exec', reader, 'cat', '/data/proof']).stdout == s.token.encode()


def docker_purpose(s):
    p = plans(('read_a', 'stop_a'))
    a, b = s.container('purpose-a'), s.container('purpose-b')
    s.context.update(A=a, B=b)
    for target, value in ((a, s.token + '-a'), (b, s.token + '-b')):
        s.call(['exec', target, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'printf %s "$1" >/tmp/identity', '_', value])
    result = bounded_read(s, s.expand(p['read_a']), a, ('/tmp/identity',))
    assert result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout == (s.token + '-a').encode()
    args = target_command(s.expand(p['stop_a']), a, ('stop', 'start', 'restart'))
    s.call(args)
    first, second = s.obj('container', a), s.obj('container', b)
    assert not first['State']['Running'] and second['State']['Running']
    assert first['Id'] != second['Id'] and first['Image'] == second['Image'] == s.image_id
    assert s.call(['exec', b, 'cat', '/tmp/identity']).stdout == (s.token + '-b').encode()


def runtime_practices(s):
    p = plans(('options',))
    args = s.expand(p['options'])
    allowed = (
        ['--user', '1000:1000', '--read-only', '--tmpfs', '/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=4m'],
        ['--read-only', '--user=1000:1000', '--tmpfs=/tmp:rw,nosuid,noexec,size=4194304'],
        ['--user', '0:0', '--read-only', '--tmpfs', '/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=4m'],
        ['--user', '1000:1000', '--tmpfs', '/tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=4m'],
    )
    assert args in allowed
    c = s.container('safe-runtime', tail=[*args, s.image, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'exec sleep 300'])
    obj = s.obj('container', c)
    assert obj['Config']['User'] == '1000:1000' and obj['HostConfig']['ReadonlyRootfs'] is True
    assert 'ALL' in obj['HostConfig']['CapDrop'] and 'no-new-privileges' in obj['HostConfig']['SecurityOpt']
    assert obj['HostConfig']['Memory'] == 33554432 and obj['HostConfig']['PidsLimit'] == 32
    assert s.call(['exec', c, 'id', '-u']).stdout.strip() == b'1000'
    status = s.call(['exec', c, 'cat', '/proc/1/status']).stdout.decode()
    assert re.search(r'^NoNewPrivs:\s+1$', status, re.M) and re.search(r'^CapEff:\s+0+$', status, re.M)
    mountinfo = s.call(['exec', c, 'cat', '/proc/self/mountinfo']).stdout.decode().splitlines()
    assert any(line.split()[4] == '/' and 'ro' in line.split()[5].split(',') for line in mountinfo)
    assert s.call(['exec', c, 'touch', '/root-proof'], check=False).returncode != 0
    s.call(['exec', c, '/bin/sh', '-c', 'printf %s "$1" >/tmp/proof', '_', s.token])
    assert s.call(['exec', c, 'cat', '/tmp/proof']).stdout == s.token.encode()

 'curated-feishu-project-018': exited_forensics,

 'src-1108be2ae400b1de': storage_root,

def run(qid):
    s = Native2()
    try:
        s.enter()
        CHECKS2[qid](s)
    finally:
        s.finish()
